name: opencode-tool-registration
body: A suite tool registered on the opencode 2.x tool domain through a synchronous transform editor: the editor adds a definition carrying a name, a description, a JSON-Schema input, and an execute that returns structured content. A transform is a replayable state edit — its callback is synchronous and free of one-time side effects — and registrations stay active for the plugin's lifetime, disposed when the plugin unloads. A later transform sees earlier changes and may update, replace, or remove them. The suite registers one tool per plugin definition.
